# native-cdp-cli (browser-tool)

> browser-tool drives headless Chrome from the shell, one command per step: a single native Rust binary speaking the Chrome DevTools Protocol, built for AI agents. Pages are read as a compact accessibility tree with [ref=N] handles. Actions are real mouse and keyboard events. A named session keeps one warm browser between shell calls. Tabs, iframes, shadow DOM and dialogs are handled for you.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrey-usa/native-cdp-cli/master/install.sh | sh` (Windows PowerShell: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrey-usa/native-cdp-cli/master/install.ps1 | iex`; or `cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/andrey-usa/native-cdp-cli browser-tool`), then `browser-tool install-skill` to put the version-matched agent guide in ./.agents/skills (`--claude` for ./.claude/skills).

Core loop: `browser-tool -s work start` → `goto <url>` → `--raw ax` → `click <ref>` / `fill <ref> "<text>"` / `press Enter` → `--raw ax` → `quit`. Every command prints one JSON line (`{"ok":true,"result":…}`), or only the result with `--raw`.

- [Agent skill (usage guide)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrey-usa/native-cdp-cli/master/.claude/skills/browser-tool/SKILL.md): the loop, reading `ax`, every command, error recovery

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrey-usa/native-cdp-cli/master/README.md): install, supported browsers, benchmarks, agent eval

## Working on the code

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrey-usa/native-cdp-cli/master/AGENTS.md): rules and the fast loop for agents changing this repo (CI via annotations, offline builds, A/B benchmarks)
